entries.zh: 得诀；掌握要诀、诀窍
entries.en: to get hold of the knack or secret formula; to grasp the trick
entries.notes: 西语栏 alcan car ellof°. 缩写残损、展开依赖推断，汉字「着訣」与对音互证为「得诀/抓住诀窍」。

entries.zh: 片脑（龙脑香冰片，香料药材）
entries.en: borneol camphor (flakes of dragon's-blood camphor, a drug and spice in Manila trade)
entries.notes: 四栏语义清晰，但闽南语栏一处声调号 T99 污损，按纪律降为 medium。

entries.zh: 起来；起身、起来
entries.en: to get up; to rise, stand up (levantarse)

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕（「末」：末尾、最后）
entries.en: 〔manuscript damaged, gloss uncertain〕('end, last')
entries.notes: 闽南语原稿音写栏 [残]，仅余汉字与官话对音，语义无法四栏互证定夺。

entries.zh: 硬争；强争（强行争占他人之物）
entries.en: to strive or contend forcibly (to take what belongs to another by force)

entries.zh: 霸占；强占他人财物
entries.en: to usurp, seize by force (what belongs to another)

entries.zh: 仗势霸占；倚仗权势占夺他人之物
entries.en: to seize by backing of power or patronage (alcarse con lo ajeno con favor del amo)

entries.zh: 吞谋；设谋吞占（用诡计逐步侵吞他人财物）
entries.en: to swallow up by scheming; to annex another's goods by intrigue and gradation
entries.notes: 闽南语栏一处声调号 T99 污损，语义由汉字与西语栏互证。

entries.zh: 乱臣；篡夺国家的叛逆之臣
entries.en: rebellious minister; one who usurps the kingdom (alcarze con el Reyno)

entries.zh: 沉没；吞没（侵吞所交付、所托付之物）
entries.en: to sink, founder; to swallow up (appropriate what was handed over)

entries.zh: 沉溺；淹没（兼指吞没所交付之物）
entries.en: to sink, drown, be submerged; to swallow up what was delivered

entries.zh: 绞网；用钩具把渔网绞起
entries.en: to haul up the net with a hook or tackle (alcar la red con garabato)

entries.zh: 粿抬起来；用杠杆（秤杆）抬起粿糕
entries.en: to lift up the rice-cake with a lever or steelyard (galanca)
entries.notes: galanca 一词 17 世纪义可为杠杆或秤杆，展开依赖推断，降为 medium。

entries.zh: 起锚；用绞车把船锚绞起
entries.en: to weigh anchor of the ship (alcar la ancla del navío)
entries.notes: 汉字「車捉」与西语「起锚」间经由绞车意象衔接，解释依赖推断。

entries.zh: 占天文地理；推算天文地理之数（算命、占星）
entries.en: to cast figures of astrology and geomancy (to divine as the mathematician does)

entries.zh: 收起；收拾（饭桌）
entries.en: to clear away the table; to gather up, put away

entries.zh: 地牛；传说中负地之牛（地震谓地牛翻身）
entries.en: earth-ox (the ox said to bear the earth; its stirring is the earthquake)
entries.notes: 西语栏 alca prima 语义不明，释义主要依据汉字与闽南语对音。

entries.zh: 牛仔；小牛
entries.en: calf; young ox/cattle

entries.zh: 扑灭；扑打消灭
entries.en: to strike down and extinguish; to wipe out, exterminate

entries.zh: 海鹅；海中水禽名（释义存疑）
entries.en: sea-goose; a marine waterfowl (gloss uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语栏 Acara - 残断不明，仅凭汉字「海鹅」与对音立义。
